modalities.evidence: using the wearable BITalino biosignal measurement device
skin conductance and respiration as raw data (unfiltered, unprocessed)

output.population: Consented spider-fearful individuals; 57 subjects in total, collected at Saarland University from July 2017 to July 2018
output.summary: Raw electrocardiogram, skin conductance and respiration recorded with a wearable device from consented spider-fearful individuals watching spider video clips during an exposure procedure, for developing online anxiety level detection algorithms.
